title: CSCI 549 — Seminar in Languages and Tools
subject: Cybersecurity
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the four practice groups of the Secure Software Development Framework and their roles in secure development.
Explain how cryptographic standards, modes of operation, and key management collectively support confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity.
Apply security reasoning to identify assets, trust boundaries, and residual risk in software development contexts.
